Class ShapeContainer

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.Shapes
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a container for shapes that can have a parent and multiple children, supporting hierarchical transformations and updates.

public abstract class ShapeContainer : Shape, IShape

Remarks

ShapeContainer enables composite shape structures, allowing for parent-child relationships and recursive updates/draws.

Parent

Gets or sets the parent of this shape container.

public ShapeContainer? Parent { get; set; }

ShapeContainer

Methods

AddChild(ShapeContainer)

Adds a child shape container to this container.

public bool AddChild(ShapeContainer child)

Parameters

child ShapeContainer

The child shape container to add.

Returns

bool

True if the child was added; false if it was already a child.

Remarks

  • If the child already has a parent, it will be removed from that parent first.
  • The child's parent will be set to this container.
  • The child will be initialized with the current transform.

ChangeParent(ShapeContainer)

Changes the parent of this shape container to a new parent.

public bool ChangeParent(ShapeContainer newParent)

Parameters

newParent ShapeContainer

The new parent to assign.

Returns

bool

True if the parent was changed; false if already assigned to the new parent.

Remarks

This will add the current shape to the new parent's children and update the parent reference.

DrawShape()

Draws this shape and all child shapes.

public override void DrawShape()

Remarks

Recursively draws all children and calls OnChildDrawn(ShapeContainer) for each child.
